# infoblox_record_alias (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Infoblox RecordAlias from the NIOS backend.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a specific alias record by filters
data "infoblox_record_alias" "get_alias_record_using_filters" {
  filters = {
    name = "alias-record.example.com"
  }
}

// Retrieve specific alias records using Extensible Attributes
data "infoblox_record_alias" "get_alias_record_using_extensible_attributes" {
  ext_attr_filters = {
    Site = "location-1"
  }
}

// Retrieve all alias records
data "infoblox_record_alias" "get_all_alias_records" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ext_attr_filters` (Map of String) Extensible Attribute Filters are used to return a more specific list of results by filtering on extensible attributes. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes.
- `max_results` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `paging` (Number) Enable (1) or disable (0) paging for the data source query. Enabled by default. When disabled, only a single page of results is retrieved.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The reference to the object.
- `nios` (Attributes) NIOS backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios))

<a id="nestedatt--results--nios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.nios`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment for the record; maximum 256 characters.
- `creator` (String) The record creator.
- `disable` (Boolean) Determines if the record is disabled or not. False means that the record is enabled.
- `ext_attrs` (Map of String) Extensible attributes associated with the object. For valid values for extensible attributes, see {extattrs:values}.
- `ext_attrs_all` (Map of String) All ext_attrs including Terraform Internal ID and inherited attributes.
- `name` (String) The name for an Alias record in FQDN format. This value can be in unicode format. Regular expression search is not supported for unicode values.
- `target_name` (String) Target name in FQDN format. This value can be in unicode format.
- `target_type` (String) Target type.
- `ttl` (Number) The Time To Live (TTL) value for record. A 32-bit unsigned integer that represents the duration, in seconds, for which the record is valid (cached). Zero indicates that the record should not be cached.
- `view` (String) The name of the DNS View in which the record resides. Example: "external".
